The Story So Far: Before door-to-door enumeration for the second phase of the Census begins in Uttar Pradesh and three other poll-bound States of Uttarakhand, Goa and Punjab on December 1, ahead of the rest of the country in January 2027, field trainers are preparing the enumerators for the challenging task ahead.
The second phase of the Census, the Population Enumeration, will ask 40 questions, and the enumerators need to spend at least 20-25 minutes with each respondent, unlike the first phase — the Houselisting Operations (HLO), which took a few minutes.
